title: Cycles and radians
hook: Change ordinary frequency and predict angular frequency.
misconception: angular frequency stays fixed when ordinary frequency doubles.
objective: Apply ω = 2πf to compare angular frequency when ordinary frequency changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a periodic wave, ω = 2πf. When ordinary frequency doubles, angular frequency becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ω = 2πf; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a periodic wave, with a nonzero initial result. If ordinary frequency triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on angular frequency?
recall.why: Apply ω = 2πf under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
